rawContent: We had online actions in May in the lead up to #BlackLivesMatter protests. @ireneayenjagoba who campaigns for regularisation of undocumented people showing up for people in Direct Provision. https://t.co/U7ZRXGwgy7

While organising #BlackLivesMatter protests, I got several calls from the police. One of then thought he'd scare me into cancelling protest. I explained to him it wasn't up to me (I only do comms). Then he spoke to me as if he was reading me a warning. https://t.co/Q2iJYqMvqm
